column1: Grease a pie pan with butter or nonstick spray.
In a large bowl, mix the melted butter, Parmesan and eggs. Set aside.
In a separate pan, sauté the onion and red pepper, then add the mushrooms.
Combine the beef and vegetables with the spaghetti sauce.
Toss the cooked spaghetti in the Parmesan, egg and butter mixture.
Press the spaghetti into the pie pan, spreading it like a pie crust.
Spread the cottage cheese over the spaghetti crust, then top with the meat sauce.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes.
